01 — CANTTELL: a page whose header, navigation, search and footer are blocks named as such, none of them a landmark
Example site
  • News
  • Contact

Scenario fixture: page-zones-landmark

A whole-document rule: one page, so one outcome. The header, the navigation, the search form and the footer are each asked about (BANNER_NOT_EXPOSED, NAVIGATION_NOT_EXPOSED, SEARCH_NOT_EXPOSED, CONTENTINFO_NOT_EXPOSED). A page whose zones are landmarks (pass), a page with none of them (notApplicable), and a page header or footer nested in a section (HEADER_NESTED, FOOTER_NESTED) are covered by the inline tests in this rule's .test.js file.
